callouts.label: README.md
callouts.hint: A page with a round information mark.
callouts.description: What the component is, how to embed it, and how to credit it.
callouts.tip: Nothing explains a component without a README.

callouts.label: quiz.js
callouts.hint: A page with two orange curly braces.
callouts.description: The script the page needs, kept inside the folder. If it lived in a sibling folder, it would not travel with the component.
callouts.tip: A script path that points outside the folder is the classic broken package.

callouts.label: index.html
callouts.hint: A page with a blue picture box and lines, the first of the six floating parts.
callouts.description: The quiz page itself. A reuser opens this file to see and use the component. All links in it must be complete addresses or point to files inside the folder.
callouts.tip: The dotted line leaving this page is the broken link that packaging prevents.

callouts.label: LICENSE.txt
callouts.hint: A page with an orange seal.
callouts.description: The license text or a link to it, so a reuser knows what they may do.
callouts.tip: A resource with no license cannot be reused with confidence.

callouts.label: metadata.json
callouts.hint: A purple tag with a hole and short lines.
callouts.description: The metadata record of Chapter 9 in a form a program can read, so a catalog can find and describe the component.
callouts.tip: Metadata is for people and for machines.

callouts.label: img/
callouts.hint: A yellow folder with a green hill picture.
callouts.description: The images the component uses, kept inside the package with complete addresses or paths inside the folder.
callouts.tip: Each image should have its own caption and alt text.

callouts.label: Three finished boxes for Watershed Basics v1.1
callouts.hint: Three closed boxes in a row at the bottom, each with a green check.
callouts.description: After splitting, Watershed Basics v1.1 has three components: the reading, the quiz, and the simulation. Each is packaged in its own box with its own license and metadata.
callouts.tip: Ready means every file is present and every link works from anywhere.
